title: Average velocity
ced_evidence: 1.2.B.2 "Average velocity is the displacement of an object divided by the interval of time in which that displacement occurs."

title: Average acceleration
ced_evidence: 1.2.B.3 "Average acceleration is the change in velocity divided by the interval of time in which that change in velocity occurs."

title: Default frame assumption
body: Unless otherwise stated, the frame of reference of any problem may be assumed to be inertial.
ced_evidence: 1.4 Boundary Statement: "Unless otherwise stated, the frame of reference of any problem may be assumed to be inertial."
